start.title: The Hollow Black Pine
start.text: A pine older than the surrounding forest rises beside the path, split by lightning and hollow from root to crown. Fresh snow around its trunk has been swept smooth by a branch or broom.

choices.text: Examine the tree without disturbing it

buckets.flavourText: You spot boot pressure under the swept snow and a wax smear inside the split trunk. This is a dead drop, not a shrine.
Someone has handled the hollow recently, but the purpose is unclear.
Nothing obvious explains why anyone would clear snow from a dead tree.

dead_drop.title: A Dead Drop
dead_drop.text: Tucked behind loose bark is a narrow oilskin packet tied with grey thread. It is positioned to be collected without leaving obvious tracks.

choices.text: Leave it exactly where it is

reach_in.title: Blind Reach
reach_in.text: The hollow is deeper than your arm. Your fingers brush twine, then cold metal.

buckets.flavourText: You trace the object before pulling: a clasped packet pinned behind loose bark.
A hidden fishhook bites your fingertip. Whoever uses the hollow dislikes careless hands.

open_packet.title: Names Without Context
open_packet.text: Inside are three scraps of paper: a list of surnames, two numbers beside each, and a charcoal sketch of the north gate. No explanation. The paper smells faintly of lamp oil.

leave_intact.title: Message for Someone Else
leave_intact.text: You press the bark back into place. Knowing that the hollow is used may be more valuable than whatever is inside.

hook.title: A Small Warning
hook.text: The hook is barbed and deliberately set. You free your finger and find a single grey thread tied to it—the same thread used by trappers to mark claimed ground.

leave.title: Nothing Owed to the Tree
leave.text: You continue on. Behind you, the hollow remains dark enough to hide a hand, a letter, or a knife.
